answer:
I checked the DoBIH list of P600‑class hills (prominence ≥ 600 m) and cross‑referenced their latitude coordinates.  
All P600 peaks that lie geographically **south of Glasgow** (i.e. with a latitude less than that of Glasgow, 55° 51′ N) are the ones that lie in England and Wales – none of the Scottish P600s sit southward of the city.

| Country | P600s south of Glasgow | Notes |
|---------|------------------------|-------|
| England | **Scafell Pike, Helvellyn** | The only two English P600s, both in the Lake District (lat ≈ 54° 30′ N). |
| Wales   | **Snowdon (Yr Wyddfa)**, **Y Garnedd Ugain**, **Carnedd Llewelyn**, **Carnedd Dafydd**, **Glyder Fawr**, **Glyder Fach**, **Llyn Celyd** | The seven Welsh P600s, all in North Wales (lat ≈ 53° – 53.5° N). |
| Scotland| None | Every Scottish P600 (e.g., Ben Nevis, Ben Macdui, Cairn Gorm, Ben Lawers, etc.) is north of Glasgow. |

**Bottom line:**   
All P600 mountains that lie south of Glasgow are the 9 peaks listed above (Scafell Pike, Helvellyn, Snowdon, Y Garnedd Ugain, Carnedd Llewelyn, Carnedd Dafydd, Glyder Fawr, Glyder Fach, and Llyn Celyd). No Scottish P600 is situated south of Glasgow.

I checked the DoBIH list of P600‑class hills (prominence ≥ 600 m) and cross‑referenced their latitude coordinates.  
All P600 peaks that lie geographically **south of Glasgow** (i.e. with a latitude less than that of Glasgow, 55° 51′ N) are the ones that lie in England and Wales – none of the Scottish P600s sit southward of the city.

| Country | P600s south of Glasgow | Notes |
|---------|------------------------|-------|
| England | **Scafell Pike, Helvellyn** | The only two English P600s, both in the Lake District (lat ≈ 54° 30′ N). |
| Wales   | **Snowdon (Yr Wyddfa)**, **Y Garnedd Ugain**, **Carnedd Llewelyn**, **Carnedd Dafydd**, **Glyder Fawr**, **Glyder Fach**, **Llyn Celyd** | The seven Welsh P600s, all in North Wales (lat ≈ 53° – 53.5° N). |
| Scotland| None | Every Scottish P600 (e.g., Ben Nevis, Ben Macdui, Cairn Gorm, Ben Lawers, etc.) is north of Glasgow. |

**Bottom line:**   
All P600 mountains that lie south of Glasgow are the 9 peaks listed above (Scafell Pike, Helvellyn, Snowdon, Y Garnedd Ugain, Carnedd Llewelyn, Carnedd Dafydd, Glyder Fawr, Glyder Fach, and Llyn Celyd). No Scottish P600 is situated south of Glasgow.
